holder_van_der_corput.statement: (Proposition 2.0.5) Suppose $\operatorname{supp}\varphi\subseteq B(z,R)$. Then $$\Big\|\int_X e^{i(f(x)-g(x))}\varphi(x)\,dx\Big\|\le C_{2.0.5}(a)\,\mu(B(z,R))\,\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{iHol}(z,2R,\tau)}\,\big(1+d_{z,R}(f,g)\big)^{-1/(2a^2+a^3)},$$ where $\tau=\tau(a)$ is the default Hölder exponent, $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{iHol}(z,2R,\tau)}$ is the (extended) inhomogeneous $\tau$-Hölder norm $\mathrm{iHolENorm}\,\varphi\,z\,(2R)\,\tau$ on the ball $B(z,2R)$, and $d_{z,R}$ is the (extended) distance between $f$ and $g$ on $B(z,R)$.
holder_van_der_corput.sketch: No named results are listed; the proof relies on ball-covering properties of the doubling space (AllBallsCoverBalls and related facts).
